reports.text: The road is well-paved and narrow.
Sadly, the road condition tends to become varied once entering Riverside County.
Very very well conditioned roads, on the Orange County side.
winding through pines and oaks, leaning deeply into endless curves
It’s full of sharp twists, corners, and hairpins as you climb into the mountains
The hairpins that grace the mountains climbing out of the desert are remarkably tight.
